Title: Public admin registration creates a full admin
Steps to reproduce: POST /api/admin/auth/register with name, email, and password. No Authorization header.
Expected: Only an existing admin can create another admin or registration is disabled after the first account.
Actual: The route is public. It creates an admin and returns access and refresh tokens.
Workaround: Block POST /api/admin/auth/register at the proxy until the route requires an admin or is removed.

Title: Token refresh is overwritten by Redux profile updates
Steps to reproduce: Stay logged in until the access token expires. Trigger any admin API call so the client refreshes tokens. Then load the layout profile or save Admin Profile.
Expected: localStorage and Redux both keep the new access and refresh tokens.
Actual: api.js writes the new tokens only to localStorage. setAdmin then writes the old Redux tokens back. The next call can 401 and log the admin out.
Evidence: AdminPannel/src/api.js refreshAdminToken; AdminPannel/src/store/authSlice.js setAdmin; AdminLayout.jsx; AdminProfile.jsx

Title: Notification opens the enquiry list and drops the id
Steps to reproduce: Create a service enquiry as a user. Open the admin bell and click the new-enquiry notification.
Actual: The link is /admin/enquiries/:id. That route redirects to /admin/venue-enquiries and discards the id.
Workaround: Search Service Enquiries by enquiry number name or phone.

Title: Forgot password reports that email was sent and no email is sent
Steps to reproduce: POST /api/admin/auth/forgot-password with a real admin email. Look for a reset mail and for a forgot-password screen on the admin login page.
Expected: The admin receives a reset link and can set a new password in the panel.
Actual: The API stores a token and returns a success message. No mail is sent. The login page has no reset flow. In development the raw token is in the JSON body.
Workaround: Reset the password in the database or call reset-password with the dev token.
Evidence: Backend/controllers/adminControllers/authController.js forgotPassword; AdminPannel login has no forgot-password page

Title: Quote amount is blank on the enquiry detail
Steps to reproduce: Create an enquiry that includes booking dates so the server prices it. Open that row in Admin > Service Enquiries.
Expected: The detail shows the calculated total.
Actual: The API stores quote.grandTotal. The panel reads quote.total so the amount is empty.

Title: Promo code screens are not in the sidebar
Steps to reproduce: Look through the admin sidebar for promo or coupon codes. Then open /admin/promo.
Expected: Promo codes are listed under Promotion Management.
Actual: The menu only has advertising Dashboard Plans and Requests. Coupon CRUD exists only at /admin/promo.

Title: Sidebar groups do not follow the active page
Steps to reproduce: 1) Collapse Service Management then open Service Enquiries. 2) Open Promotion Management > Plans. 3) Open Orders.
Expected: The group that contains the page stays open and highlighted. Orders does not highlight Ecom.
Actual: venue-enquiries is missing from pathInGroup. promotion-ads is never auto-opened. The ecom regex includes orders so Ecom looks active on the Orders page.

Title: Child categories cannot be managed in admin and products ignore them
Steps to reproduce: Look for a Child Categories screen. Create a product in admin and inspect the payload.
Expected: Admin can create and assign a child category.
Actual: There is no screen. Product add and edit always send childCategory as an empty string. The API /api/admin/child-categories exists and vendors can create them.
Evidence: Backend/routes/index.js child-categories; AdminPannel/src/api/adminChildCategories.js; ProductAdd.jsx and ProductEdit.jsx payload

Title: Commission Reports and Recharge routes still say Coming soon
Expected: Those areas are either removed or implemented. Recharge history is the Mobile Gas and Fastag pages.
Actual: Each URL renders a Coming soon placeholder. The sidebar links are commented out.
Workaround: Use Mobile Recharge Gas Recharge and Fastag Recharge for recharge history.

Title: Password reset token is stored in plain text
Steps to reproduce: Call forgot-password for an admin and read resetPasswordToken on the admin document. In development also read the JSON response.
Expected: The stored value is a hash. The raw token is not returned by the API.
Actual: The database stores the same token the client must send. Development responses include resetToken.
Workaround: Treat a database export as enough to reset admin passwords until those tokens expire.

Title: Pending approval does not deactivate an already active vendor
Steps to reproduce: PATCH /api/admin/vendors/:id with approvalStatus pending for a vendor that is already approved and active.
Expected: approvalStatus becomes pending and status becomes inactive.
Actual: approvalStatus becomes pending and status stays active. The edit form disables this field so the panel does not send it. Approve and reject on the view page are fine.
Workaround: Use Reject on the vendor view page or set status inactive in the edit form.

Title: Invalid daily hours fail as a validation error
Steps to reproduce: POST /api/admin/hot-deals/rules with dailyStartHour set to a non-numeric string such as abc.
Expected: The API returns 400 with a clear invalid hour message.
Actual: Number(abc) becomes NaN and the save fails mongoose validation.
Workaround: Use the panel hour inputs which only send numbers.
